title: Backend Stack Manifest
description: Per-variant stack declaration and verify contract consumed by `oma verify agent backend` and agent structured lookup.

language.description: Primary implementation language. Shipped variants cover python, node, and rust; the stack-set workflow (`source: detected`) may also produce go, java, kotlin, elixir, ruby, csharp, and others.

framework.description: Primary web framework (e.g., litestar, nestjs, axum).

orm.description: Primary ORM/query layer (e.g., sqlalchemy, prisma, sqlx).

source.description: Origin marker. `variant` = shipped with repo, `preset` = a shipped variant chosen at install and copied into stack/, `migrated` = produced by legacy migration, `user` = hand-customized, `detected` = generated by the stack-set workflow from codebase detection.

verify.description: Executable contract run by `oma verify agent backend` (cli/commands/verify/stack-checks.ts).

detect.description: Manifest file that identifies this stack (e.g., package.json). Informational: no verify check reads it.

raw_sql.description: Raw-SQL injection scan: an in-process line-by-line regex scan of the workspace (node_modules and .git are always skipped).

patterns.description: Patterns joined with `|` into one JavaScript RegExp and tested against each line.

include_glob.description: Glob matched against the file basename (e.g., `*.ts`).

exclude_dirs.description: Terms that exclude a hit when they appear anywhere in its `./path:line:text` record; usually directory names.
